title: The Tiny Giant
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: Being big is not about size. It is about the heart, and what you do with it.
short_description: The smallest creature in the forest is sure he is a giant, and one stormy day he gets the chance to prove it.
long_description: Pip is the smallest creature in the whole forest. He can hide behind a single blade of grass, and a raindrop could give him a bath. So of course he tells everyone he is a giant. When a great wind knocks down nests and homes, tiny Pip sets out to do something truly enormous: he digs a new home for a family of mice, repairs a fallen bird's nest high in the great tree, and gathers every small creature in the forest to clear the fox's play area together. In the end the oldest squirrel tells him the truth he always knew: being big is not about size, it is about the heart.
visual_style: High-quality 3D animated children's illustration (cinematic children's animation), lush miniature forest world seen from a tiny creature's scale, warm dappled sunlight, glowing bokeh, glossy toy-like rendering

art_direction.scale_rule: Everything in the forest is drawn at an enormous scale relative to Pip: a blade of grass taller than he is, a pebble like a hill, a mushroom like a stage, a dewdrop as big as his head.
art_direction.character_lock: Pip must be exactly the same character on every page: a very small round creature with soft mint-green fur, a cream belly, huge round ears like a fennec fox, big bright amber eyes, a small black nose, tiny paws and feet, a tuft of fluff on top of his head.
art_direction.single_instance_rule: Pip appears exactly once per page. Two pages were regenerated because a duplicate Pip appeared in the frame.

main_characters.name: Pip
